pages.text: $(bold)Fortress$() — +6 armor, +3 toughness. The highest base defensive stats of any class. pages.title: The Tank Tradeoff
pages.text: The -15% damage penalty is real. The $(thing)Vanguard$() kills things slowly. But the $(thing)Vanguard$() does not die. With +20% HP, +6 armor, +3 toughness, and Guardian aura, this class can stand in fights that would kill any other class.$(br2)$(bold)Best race pairings:$()$(br)$(thing)Dwarf$() — +8% armor effectiveness on top of Fortress = the tankiest possible build.$(br)$(thing)Orc$() — Attack speed partially compensates for the damage penalty.$(br)$(thing)Revenant$() — Night power bonus helps offset the -15% damage penalty.
